i18n.i18nString: The login name. Must be unique in this instance.

"All versions" is what you want almost every time.

The invitation goes here. It also becomes the login name.
Optional. Roles picked here are already in place when the person first signs in.

A log of this counter. Who is still waiting for their invitation is on the Users card, in state "Invited".
